Names of the three Karni facilities and products made at Bichhwal Unit-III and Karni units 2-3.

Current solar PV capacity (kWp) - BRSR FY2024-25 only says capacity at Karni was 'enhanced'; last public figure is 1,800 kW (RHP 2022).
Quantitative ESG targets - BRSR says a sustainability roadmap is 'in the process of finalizing' (p.161); only the planned 3,00,000 litres/day wastewater recycling plant (launched Jan 2025) is stated.
GHG gas-wise breakup and Scope 3 categories - not given.
Water discharge volumes - not quantified (ZLD statement only).

Subsidiary CINs (except Bikaji Foundation) and AOC-1 financials - Annual Report AOC-1 not reached.
PLI scheme unit list - the investor presentation refers to a 'PLI impact' on revenue, but no unit-wise PLI disclosure was found.
Differently abled employees/workers for FY2023-24 beyond the zero permanent count seen; FY2024-25 is all zero.
